title: Dive deeper into Writing Tools
description: With Writing Tools, people can proofread, rewrite, and transform text directly within your app. Learn advanced techniques to customize Writing Tools for your app. Explore formatting options and how they work with rich text editing. If you have a custom text engine, learn how to seamlessly integrate the complete Writing Tools experience, allowing edits directly within the text view.
